content.description: Islamic knowledge management and educational platform that helps educational institutions and Islamic centers deliver Quranic studies, manage religious content, and coordinate community activities. Built with ASP.NET, VB.NET, C#, this platform provides a complete solution for organizations seeking to modernize their operations. The system integrates multiple capabilities into a unified interface, reducing complexity and improving operational efficiency. Designed for both technical and non-technical users, it bridges the gap between organizational needs and technological capabilities.

use_cases.title: Browse Quranic Content
use_cases.description: Access and read the Holy Quran with multiple viewing options, search capabilities, and reference tools for students and teachers. This capability enables teams to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

use_cases.title: Track Islamic Dates
use_cases.description: Automatically calculate and display Hijri calendar dates with Gregorian conversions for planning religious events. This capability enables teams to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

use_cases.title: Manage Educational Articles
use_cases.description: Create, edit, and publish Islamic knowledge articles and educational materials for community access and learning. This capability enables teams to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

use_cases.title: Send Community Notifications
use_cases.description: Distribute automated email announcements for prayers, events, and important dates to registered community members. This capability enables teams to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Religious Events
use_cases.description: Schedule and manage Islamic events, prayer times, and community gatherings with automated reminders. This capability enables teams to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

use_cases.title: Administer User Access
use_cases.description: Control who can view, edit, and manage different sections of educational content based on roles and permissions. This capability enables teams to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

use_cases.title: Generate Printed Materials
use_cases.description: Create printable versions of Quranic text, calendar schedules, and educational content for offline distribution. This capability enables teams to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

use_cases.title: Monitor Content Usage
use_cases.description: Track which educational materials are being accessed and by whom to improve content delivery. This capability enables teams to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.
